title: Top Phones Under $500 & $300 (2026)
summary: The Pixel 10a is the best all-rounder under $500, with the Galaxy A37 for long support, the Nothing Phone (4a) Pro for zoom and the Moto G Power for under $300.
method: Picks come from TechRepublic, PhoneArena, Mobility Arena, TechRadar, Tom's Guide and T3. Only phones named by at least two of these sources are listed.
assumptions: We show no prices because phone prices change often. OnePlus left the US market in July 2026, so we leave out OnePlus Nord phones.

products.name: Google Pixel 10a
why: PhoneArena names the Pixel 10a its best phone under $500 for balanced features and an amazing camera. TechRepublic picks it for balanced everyday use, and Mobility Arena lists it among the safest unlocked picks under $500.
TechRadar and Tom's Guide also name it the best budget Android phone and best value Android phone.
pros: Clean software with long Google support
products.best_for: Most people who want one great, simple Android phone
products.skip_if: You want a telephoto zoom lens
products.amazon_listing: Google Pixel 10a - 30+ Hours Battery, Camera Coach, Gemini - Obsidian 256GB | Gemini Live,

products.name: Samsung Galaxy A37 5G
why: TechRepublic names the Galaxy A37 5G the best sub-$500 phone for long software support, and Mobility Arena lists it among the safest unlocked phones under $500 at current pricing.
Mobility Arena notes the Galaxy A57 5G has moved above the $500 line.
cons: Slower processor than $600 to $800 phones (Mobility Arena)
products.best_for: Buyers who keep their phone for many years
products.skip_if: You want the best camera zoom or fastest chip
products.amazon_listing: Samsung Galaxy A37 5G (2026), Unlocked Android Smartphone, 128GB, AMOLED Display, Triple C

products.name: Nothing Phone (4a) Pro
why: TechRepublic says the Nothing Phone (4a) Pro stands apart from most sub-$500 phones with a 50MP periscope camera offering 3.5x optical zoom. T3 and Tom's Guide both gave it a 2026 award as a top budget phone.
TechRepublic notes the $499 version has 128GB and the 256GB model costs more than $500.
pros: Real optical zoom at this price
products.best_for: Photo fans who want zoom without paying flagship prices
products.skip_if: You need the longest software support
products.amazon_listing: Nothing Phone (4a) Pro Cell Phone, Android 16 Smartphone (Black, 8+128GB) | Triple-Lens Ca

products.name: Motorola Moto G Power (2026)
why: TechRepublic names the Moto G Power 2026 its best pick for spending under $300, with a 5,200mAh battery and 50MP camera. Tom's Guide's battery test also lists it at about 18 hours.
TechRepublic warns that Motorola schedules its security updates only through January 2029.
cons: Shorter update support than Google or Samsung
products.best_for: Buyers who want the cheapest phone with great battery
products.skip_if: You want long updates or a premium camera
products.amazon_listing: Motorola Moto G Power - 2025 | Unlocked | Made for US 8/128GB | 50MP Camera | Leaf Green

products.name: Samsung Galaxy A17 5G
why: Mobility Arena calls the Galaxy A17 5G the strongest overall pick under $300, mainly because of its six years of promised OS and security updates, far more than most budget phones. BGR names the Galaxy A26 5G the best Samsung phone under $300.
PhoneArena and UpPhone also pick the Galaxy A16 5G as the best option at the cheapest prices, which the A17 succeeds.
specs: Six years of OS and security updates (Mobility Arena)
pros: Longest software support in the price range
products.best_for: Buyers who want a cheap phone they can keep for years
products.skip_if: You want the best camera or fastest speed
products.amazon_listing: Samsung Galaxy A17 5G Smart Phone 128GB, US 1 Yr Manufacturer Warranty Blue | Large AMOLED

products.name: Motorola Moto G Play (2026)
products.badge: Best battery on a tight budget
why: Gizmochina ranks the Moto G Play (2026) first on its under-$300 list for its blend of features and all-day battery. Mobility Arena lists it among the safest unlocked picks under $300, and Tom's Guide's battery test lists it at about 18 hours 50 minutes.
It is cheaper than the standard Moto G while nearly matching its battery life (Tom's Guide).
products.best_for: Buyers who want long battery for the least money
products.skip_if: You want lots of storage or long updates
products.amazon_listing: Motorola Moto G Play - 2026 | Unlocked | Made for US 4/64GB | 32MP Camera | Pantone Tapest

products.name: Motorola Moto G (2026)
why: Tom's Guide ranks the Moto G (2026) first for battery at 19 hours 10 minutes. Mobility Arena lists it among the safest picks under $300 but notes the price rose after launch because of memory-chip costs.
That price rise puts it right at the edge of the $300 line.
cons: Price has risen to the edge of $300
products.best_for: Budget buyers who want extra storage and longer battery
products.skip_if: The price has gone over your budget
products.amazon_listing: Motorola Moto G Power - 2026 | Unlocked | Made for US 8/128GB | 50MP Camera | Pantone Pure
